events.description: Resupply mission of the Static Tank will be done in the near future, but there is no clear schedule yet.
events.source_quote:
We received notice from Mission control at 10:30 that a resupply mission
of the Static Tank will be done in the near future. However we don't have
yet a clear schedule for its resolution.

questions_to_mission_support.text: We're requesting approval of an EVA on Jan 15th 2015.
questions_to_mission_support.source_quote: We're requesting approval of an EVA on Jan 15th 2015.
